explanation: Copying and diagnostic histories dominate the current loop; parallel replays trade RAM for throughput.

hypotheses.copying: Named copy/clone/serialization functions account for at least 30% of sampled own CPU time.
hypotheses.diagnostics: Discarding estimator trace and controller decision history reduces median whole-night time by at least 20%, preserving all runNight outputs.
hypotheses.scaling: At least one of 2/4/6 workers improves median replay throughput by at least 50% over serial, with identical final snapshot hashes.
hypotheses.deltaGate: Three independent no-op repeats should pass a 20% resource tolerance; redundant identical replays and a touched 64 MiB buffer should be detected without changing the semantic hashes.
hypotheses.deadlines: UNKNOWN without current device execution and independently measured deadlines.

replay.qualification: Diagnostic block, not a population win-rate census; no policy selection or reliability estimate.

stoppingRule: Fixed cells; each child bounded at 120 seconds; stop on trace mismatch, never tune based on timing.
